_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Avrahm Yarmolinsky (1890-1975): Saltykov-Shchedrin's A Family of Noblemen (The Golovlyov Family, 1917) and The Shield (Gorky, Andreyev and Sologub, eds., 1917). Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 31); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
